tests.name: shared_false_model
tests.construction: Several observers share the same false internal model and utter matching statements.

tests.name: coherent_hallucination
tests.construction: An internally coherent perception-model-statement chain lacks a matching external referent.

tests.name: correct_model_false_utterance
tests.construction: The internal model is accurate, but the speaker intentionally or accidentally utters a different proposition.

tests.name: wrong_model_matching_utterance
tests.construction: The model and utterance match each other while both contradict the target state.

tests.name: artifact_corruption
tests.construction: A past artifact is altered or partially lost before present reception.

tests.name: semantic_drift
tests.construction: The same preserved symbols receive a different meaning in a later interpretive community.

tests.name: carrier_loss
tests.construction: All physical carriers and reconstructive processes for an encoded distinction are destroyed.

tests.name: later_reinterpretation
tests.construction: A present reader changes the interpretation and future use of an old artifact.

tests.name: majority_error
tests.construction: A large majority accepts a proposition contradicted by later independent measurements.

tests.name: forward_information_chain
tests.construction: Past event -> artifact -> present reception -> future action, with no edge returning to the past event.
